pretreatment: a five nm thick, amorphous Al2O3 film was deposited by ALD from AlCl3 and water right before the iridium deposition
surface_functionalization: to produce a uniform coverage of hydroxyl groups on the surface
evidence: Unless otherwise noted, a five nm thick, amorphous Al2O3 film was deposited by ALD from AlCl3 and water26 right before the iridium deposition. The function of the Al2O3 layer is to produce a uniform coverage of hydroxyl groups on the surface which results in more uniform deposits, especially on the borosilicate glass substrate, as was noticed also in our previous study with ruthenium.
